findings.evidence_quote: Fiserv Announces Transfer of Stock Exchange Listing to Nasdaq - Fiserv, Inc. Skip to content NASDAQ: FISV $45.85
findings.reason: The company’s current investor-relations announcement page displays Fiserv, Inc. together with NASDAQ ticker FISV; it also reports the transfer of its common-stock listing to Nasdaq, with trading expected to begin November 11, 2025. The current-stage discovery revealed no completed take-private, delisting, or controlling acquisition.
